settings.content:
All three formulas in our MB-1 product line were designed to support metabolic health through a comprehensive 3-month system, but each was developed for different needs.

MB-1 is our original formula, designed to support healthy weight management, appetite regulation, blood sugar metabolism, and calorie burning. 

MB-1 45+ builds on the foundation of MB-1 with additional support tailored to the hormonal and metabolic changes that occur during perimenopause, menopause, and beyond, including added support for estrogen balance, cortisol, and sleep. 

MB-1 Max is our most advanced metabolic formula. Built on the foundation of MB-1, it features 2x the chromium, 100 mg of naturally occurring caffeine, saffron, and additional weight management ingredients to provide more comprehensive support for body composition, cravings control, energy, and mood. If you're unsure which formula is right for you, please reach out- our team is always happy to help.
settings.title: What is the difference between MB-1, MB-1 45+, and MB-1 Max?

settings.content:
Rather than relying on harsh stimulants, appetite suppressants, laxatives, or quick-fix trends, 

MB-1 Max takes a more comprehensive approach by combining clinically studied ingredients at  research backed dosages to support the key biological and behavioral factors that influence metabolic health. By bringing together botanicals, vitamins, minerals, and a postbiotic, MB-1 Max supports body composition, blood sugar metabolism, GLP-1 production, gut health, and calorie burning, while also supporting daily habits through cravings control, energy, mood, and motivation. The result is a more advanced approach that works with your body's natural metabolic processes to support sustainable, long-term results you can both see and feel.
settings.title: What makes MB-1 Max different from other natural metabolic solutions?

settings.content: We do not recommend taking MB-1 Max alongside MB-1 or MB-1 45+, as the formulas contain overlapping ingredients and were designed to be used independently. MB-1 Max is our most comprehensive metabolic health formula and was developed to provide support across multiple aspects of metabolic wellness in a single daily protocol. If you're unsure which product is right for you, please reach out to our team and we'd be happy to help guide you.
settings.title: Can I take MB-1 Max with my MB-1 or MB-1 45+ together?

settings.content: Yes. MB-1 Max was formulated for both men and women ages 18+ looking to support their metabolic health. Whether your goal is to feel more in control of cravings, support healthy weight management, maintain energy and motivation, or take a more comprehensive approach to metabolic health, MB-1 Max can help you support your goals.
settings.title: Can men and women both take MB-1 Max?

settings.content: Yes. MB-1 Max contains 100 mg of natural caffeine from sustainably and ethically sourced green coffee bean extract to help support clean energy, focus, and motivation. The formula was designed to provide metabolic support without the jitters or crash commonly associated with high-stimulant products. If you are sensitive to caffeine, we recommend assessing your tolerance before use, and making sure to take in the morning with food.
settings.title: Does MB-1 Max contain stimulants or caffeine?

settings.content: In most cases, yes. However, because supplement regimens can vary widely, we recommend consulting your doctor before combining MB-1 Max with other supplements, especially if they contain overlapping ingredients or are intended to support similar health goals.
